get.description: Retrieves the details of a single field by its ID.

patch.description: Updates an existing field by its ID.

delete.description: Deletes an existing field by its ID.

get.description: Retrieves fields for the specified module.

parameters.name: apiNames
parameters.description: Comma-separated API names of the fields to retrieve. Only the specified fields are returned.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Expression to selectively fetch fields based on a field property. For example: isCustomField='false' AND isComputed='false'.

parameters.name: module
parameters.description: API name of the module in which the field must be created.Possible values: System-defined modules such as tickets, contacts, accounts, tasks, timeEntry, products, calls, events, contracts, and agents. Custom modules are also supported.

parameters.name: associatedDepartments
parameters.description: Restricts the response to fields associated with the specified department. Only fields that are part of at least one layout in the given department are returned. Accepts a single department ID.

post.description: Creates a new field for the specified module.

parameters.name: module
parameters.description: API name of the module in which the field must be created.Possible values: System-defined modules such as tickets, contacts, accounts, tasks, timeEntry, products, calls, events, contracts, and agents. Custom modules are also supported.

type.description: Type of the field. Always "Text" for text field responses.

name.description: Name of the custom field. Note: This attribute is deprecated. Use displayLabel instead.

apiName.description: Unique read-only name of the field.

displayLabel.description: Name of the field in the UI.

type.description: Data type of the field. Accepted values: Text, URL, Textarea, Email, Phone, Multiselect, Date, DateTime, Number, Percent, Decimal, Currency, Picklist, LookUp, MultiLookup, AutoNumber, Boolean, Fax, LargeText, Formula.

maxLength.description: Maximum permissible length of the field value.

isMandatory.description: Indicates whether the field is mandatory. Accepted values: true (mandatory), false (not mandatory).

isCustomField.description: Indicates whether the field is a custom field. Accepted values: true (custom field), false (system field).

isEncryptedField.description: Indicates whether the field value is encrypted. Accepted values: true (encrypted), false (not encrypted).

isTrackLastActivityTime.description: Specifies whether the last activity is tracked for the field.

isIndexed.description: Specifies whether the field is indexed.

isComputed.description: Specifies whether the field is computed.

isInternalState.description: Specifies whether the field is internal.

isBasic.description: Specifies whether the field is a basic field.

isIdentifier.description: Whether the field is the identifier for the record.

isPresence.description: Specifies whether the field is enabled.

isSortable.description: Specifies whether the field is sortable.

sourceType.description: Specifies the source of field creation, whether it was created by the system, a user, or an extension.

createdBy.description: ID of the user who created the field.

modifiedBy.description: ID of the user who last modified the field.

showToHelpCenter.description: Indicates whether the field is available in the Help Center. Accepted values: true (available in the Help Center), false (not available in the Help Center).

toolTipType.description: Type of the tooltip. Accepted values: placeHolder, icon.

associatedDepartments.description: Departments this field is associated with. Only returned on GET single-field responses; omitted on create, update, and list responses.

name.description: Display name of a department this field is associated with (the field appears in at least one layout in that department).

hasMore.description: Whether more associated departments are available beyond those returned.

href.description: URL to retrieve the associated departments.
